card.name: Imaging agent dosing text
card.fires_on: Words inside radiology and contrast-imaging label text, such as section numbers, parts of contrast or tracer names, units like MBq, and x-ray. It fires on the middle of these items, not on ordinary prose.

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: The digit starting a section number inside a cross-reference in imaging drug labels.

modes.label: Inside imaging names and units
modes.description: Partway through contrast agent names, x-ray, or radioactivity units.

modes.label: Linking words in dosing
modes.description: Small words like or and for between rest and stress imaging steps.
